findings.evidence: Each mem_iff body is `<symmetric_lemma> (mapsTo_conj_of_mem_iff hΩ) ...` (lines 210, 240, 376, 402); the `_of_symmetric` targets are context (existing) lines 186, 216, 359, 383.
findings.fix: Keep only `mapsTo_conj_of_mem_iff` and delete the four `_of_mem_iff` wrappers; the L4 assembly calls `image_conj_inter_im_pos_of_symmetric (mapsTo_conj_of_mem_iff hsymm)` etc. directly.
findings.issue: The four `_of_mem_iff` lemmas (image_conj_inter_im_pos_of_mem_iff:207, image_conj_inter_im_neg_of_mem_iff:237, differentiableOn_conj_conj_inter_im_neg_of_mem_iff:371, differentiableOn_schwarzReflection_inter_im_neg_of_mem_iff:398) are a parallel API over the existing `_of_symmetric` lemmas, each just applying `mapsTo_conj_of_mem_iff`. This duplicates the whole surface for a hypothesis conversion that is already a single public lemma.

findings.evidence: Bodies at 81, 90, 104, 113, 322, 332 are pure specializations of the general lemmas at 73/95/310; grep shows no in-file callers of the six specializations.
findings.fix: Drop these specializations; downstream callers apply the general `_of_subset_` lemma with the appropriate subset proof. Re-add a specialization only when a concrete consumer needs it.
findings.issue: Consumer-less trivial specializations re-derive the general `_of_subset_` lemmas: eqOn_schwarzReflection_im_nonneg:79, eqOn_schwarzReflection_inter_im_nonneg:88, eqOn_schwarzReflection_im_neg:101, eqOn_schwarzReflection_inter_im_neg:110, differentiableOn_schwarzReflection_im_pos:319, differentiableOn_schwarzReflection_inter_im_pos:329. Each is a one-line `Subset.rfl`/`inter_subset_right`/`.2.le` application of `eqOn_schwarzReflection_of_subset_im_nonneg`/`_neg` or `differentiableOn_schwarzReflection_of_subset_im_nonneg`, and none is used within the PR.

summary: The PR ships a full parallel `_of_mem_iff` family that duplicates the existing `_of_symmetric` lemmas via the trivial new bridge `mapsTo_conj_of_mem_iff`, plus several consumer-less trivial specializations of the general `_of_subset_` lemmas. Collapse the parallel API and drop the unused special cases.
